versions.subject: Create image_load_side_load_solidpdfcreator.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\SolidPDFCreator.dll'
filter:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\'
condition: selection and not filter
